definitions.gloss: gaping; open-mouthed; with mouth wide open in surprise or shock
definitions.explanation: Describes the state of having one's mouth open wide, typically from shock, surprise, or disbelief. A vivid mimetic expression.

examples.japanese: あんぐり{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける。
{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}の{金額|きんがく}を{見|み}てあんぐりした。
examples.english: I was left gaping when I saw the amount on the bill.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{突拍子|とっぴょうし}もない{発言|はつげん}に、{全員|ぜんいん}があんぐりと{口|くち}を{開|あ}けた。
examples.english: Everyone gaped open-mouthed at his outrageous remark.

notes:
A mimetic word that vividly evokes the image of a mouth hanging open in shock. Often used with {口|くち}を{開|あ}ける (to open one's mouth) or simply as あんぐりする.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あんぐりする: to gape, to be left open-mouthed
- あんぐり{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける: to gape with mouth wide open
- あんぐりと{口|くち}を{開|あ}けた: gaped open-mouthed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぽかんと: blankly — mouth open from being dazed or spacing out; less shock
- {唖然|あぜん}と: speechless — formal word for being struck dumb with shock
- {開|あ}いた{口|くち}が{塞|ふさ}がらない: jaw-dropping (idiom) — so shocked one can't close one's mouth
- びっくり: surprised — general surprise; not specifically about the mouth
